domain_label: Sweater Finishing & Post-Treatment — Process Landscape, Anti-Pill Routes & the Garment Gate
purpose: A method for reasoning about what each post-knit finishing step does for a sweater's hand, quality and care across the three-article California line (A1 cotton-blend core, A2 fine-acrylic value, A3 merino/lambswool premium) — scour/wash, wool-only milling/fulling, the four fibre-specific anti-pill routes, silicone softening, steam-press/boarding/relax-compaction, and the yarn-vs-piece-vs-garment dye choice — anchored on one core truth: anti-pill is fibre-route-specific (there is NO universal anti-pill finish) and finishing is the second line of pilling defence, never a yarn fix, so the brand owns only the two-PO recipe plus the finished-garment post-wash test gate and outsources 100% of the wet/regulated steps.
assumptions: no observed per-vendor Ludhiana finishing cost supplied; every cost/temperature/time/dose/MOQ band is a labeled estimate with method+basis+confidence and the literal word estimate, never a fake-precise point, and the per-garment finishing job-work rate at a named finisher stays UNKNOWN and is named as the T4 blocker rather than fabricated

the three articles are fixed upstream by the yarn line: A1 cotton-blend 12GG core, A2 fine-acrylic 7-12GG value, A3 merino/lambswool 7-12GG premium, each carrying its own ICI post-wash pilling floor (A1/A2 >=3-4, A3 >=4)

process identities (milling is wool-only and irreversible, cellulase acts on cellulosics only, relaxation shrinkage is common to all fibres, singeing beads/melts on thermoplastic acrylic) are true-by-definition FACT, not estimate
the dyeing and all wet/effluent nodes are outsourced as a non-negotiable inherited boundary; owning any wet node imports cluster closure/effluent risk wildly out of proportion to a three-article line

performance magnitudes (ICI-grade uplift per route, the fraction a chemical anti-pill top-up buys on acrylic) are directionally HIGH but magnitude LOW until PPS swatch trials, and any off-paper cluster economy is described as mechanism not accusation with amounts UNKNOWN
exclusions: the upstream yarn spinning dials and yarn PO grade-setting (staple, twist, ply, fineness, blend ratio) which are the first line of pilling defence and belong to the yarn specialist, referenced here only where the two POs must carry the same gate
stating an actual per-garment finishing job-work rate for a named Ludhiana finisher as fact (it is an UNKNOWN blocker, never invented)
owning, building, or operating any wet-processing, dyehouse, or effluent node (the brand outsources 100% of wet/regulated steps)
garment-side QC scorecard mechanics and the thread-checker device design, which are the quality specialist's deliverable and consume the finishing gate as input rather than redefining it
the downstream landed-cost and unit-economics model, brand positioning, and AI design, which consume the finishing recipe and gate but are out of scope here

competency_questions.question: What does the post-knit finishing chain do step by step, and which steps do not apply to every garment?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: FINISHING_CHAIN_SPINE lays out scour -> (wool-only) mill -> anti-pill -> soften -> dry -> press/board -> relax/compact -> gate and SCOUR_WASH states the first wet step and its under-scouring patchy-uptake failure, with the wool-only and per-fibre steps flagged as not-universal

competency_questions.question: Why is milling wool-only and irreversible, and why is it gated on a felt/area-shrink limit rather than a clock?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: MILLING_FULLING states milling is the same physics as accidental shrink-felting deliberately stopped at a target, applies to woollen-spun A3 only, is irreversible if over-done, and must be gated on dimensions + a felt/area-shrink limit + hand, never to the clock

competency_questions.question: What are the four real anti-pill routes, which fibre does each attach to, and why is there no universal anti-pill finish?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: ANTIPILL_ROUTE_MAP names singeing (cotton yarn-stage), cellulase bio-polish (cotton/cellulosic garment), chemical/silicone (acrylic primary, fraction only), and low-pill fibre+nylon% (upstream, not a finish), and states that route is dictated by fibre chemistry so a generic anti-pill spec is a category error

competency_questions.question: How does cotton (A1) earn a real anti-pill grade at finishing, and why must bio-polish carry a retained-strength cap?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: BIOPOLISH_CELLULASE explains cellulase hydrolyses cellulosic micro-fibrils so it removes fibre and costs tensile strength, must be enzyme-inactivated afterwards, and the spec must name both the target hand and a minimum retained bursting/tensile strength, and A1_COTTON_RECIPE ties gas-singe yarn + bio-polish garment + the strength cap together

competency_questions.question: Why is acrylic (A2) pilling won or lost at the yarn PO and not on the finishing line?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: A2_ACRYLIC_RECIPE states acrylic is thermoplastic (a flame beads/melts it, can't be cleanly singed) and non-cellulosic (cellulase does nothing), so most defence is the anti-pill/high-dpf yarn grade and finishing adds only a chemical/silicone fraction; the fix for cheap acrylic is re-opening the yarn spec, not piling on anti-pill

competency_questions.question: What makes A3 wool a buy-the-craft article and what are its mandatory finishing dials?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: A3_WOOL_RECIPE names milling (woollen-spun only, light/none on worsted merino) + boarding + felt-relax as the craft, a few-percent nylon upstream as the cheapest pill/abrasion lever, an ICI >=4 floor, and milling time as the irreversible pass/fail dial

competency_questions.question: What does silicone softening do for hand, and how can it mask a harsh yarn?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SOFTENING_HAND states silicone gives the expensive 3-second hand and lowers abrasion but can MASK a harsh yarn (great showroom, harsh after one wash), so the spec must require a wash-durable softener and test hand after a wash, hydrophilic silicone on cotton and amino on wool

competency_questions.question: How do steam-press, boarding and relax/compaction deliver the measurements and the home-wash promise?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PRESS_BOARD_BLOCK states heat+moisture sets final dimensions and relaxes knit stress (where the tech-pack measurements are hit, critical for the FF premium read) and RELAX_COMPACT states relaxation shrinkage is spent in the factory not the customer's machine, then compacted to a residual-shrink limit and steam-set to lock it

competency_questions.question: Which dye stage do we launch on and why never own the dye node?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: DYE_STAGE_CHOICE compares fibre/yarn vs piece vs garment dyeing on the fastness-vs-agility trade, sets launch on yarn/package-dyed bought stock shades, reserves garment-dye for a proven hero style, never piece-dye-and-cut as core, and outsources the dye node with a lot-to-lot delta-E + fastness clause

competency_questions.question: Why does the finishing recipe span two purchase orders and why must both carry the same gate?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: TWO_PO_RECIPE states singe and mercerise happen at the yarn supplier while the wet+mechanical steps happen at the garment finisher, and both POs must carry the same post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate or a step skipped at one vendor quietly passes the test at the other

competency_questions.question: Why outsource 100% of the wet/regulated steps and own only the spec plus the test gate?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: OUTSOURCE_WET_BOUNDARY states wet processing makes regulated effluent (cluster CETP non-compliance, CPCB penalties, NGT review), the kit is capital+skill+volume-bound for a micro-line, and the one ownable sliver is the two-PO recipe + the finished-garment acceptance gate, with leverage contractual not a device

competency_questions.question: What are the checks on the finished garment and which standard grades pilling?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: FINISHED_GARMENT_GATE lists the eight post-wash checks (pilling, shrinkage, spirality, retained strength, hand durability, milling felt-limit, shade delta-E/fastness, workmanship AQL) and PILLING_TEST_METHOD fixes ISO 12945-1 box (not -2 Martindale), 1-5 to half-grade after >=1 wash with the method spec'd not just the number

competency_questions.question: How is the finishing gate the garment-side half of the per-lot scorecard, and what is fed back to the named supplier?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: OWN_SPEC_GATE ties the pilling/shrinkage/shade subset to the per-lot scorecard-and-code returned to the named supplier, extending the yarn-lot gate onto the garment so testing both ends closes the loop, and states the two POs carry the same gate

competency_questions.question: Given fibre route, the irreversible milling risk, the masking trap and the two-PO gate, what is the merged go/no-go on a finishing recipe for an article?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: RECIPE_GO_NOGO composes the fibre-specific route, the irreversible-step guard, the anti-masking wash test and the two-PO same-gate rule into a defensible spec/no-spec verdict per article (A1 spec fully, A2 win upstream + finish light, A3 buy the craft at ICI>=4), refusing any recipe that promises finishing will fix a cheap yarn

glossary.definition: The binding honesty label on every cost/temperature/time/dose/MOQ band in this KB: the figure is a triangulated estimate with method+basis+confidence and the literal word estimate, never a measured per-vendor finishing rate; a genuinely missing number such as the per-garment Ludhiana job-work rate stays UNKNOWN and is named as a blocker.

Controlled wet+heat+agitation that felts and closes up a woollen knit into a fuller, softer, warmer, hairier hand; the same physics as accidental shrink-felting deliberately stopped at a target; wool-only, irreversible if over-done, and gated on a felt/area-shrink limit and hand, never to the clock.

One of the four real anti-pill mechanisms, each attached to a fibre: gas-singeing (cotton yarn-stage), cellulase bio-polish (cotton/cellulosic garment), chemical/silicone bonding (acrylic primary, a fraction of a grade), and low-pill fibre + nylon% (upstream, not a finish); there is no universal anti-pill finish, so a generic anti-pill spec across fibres is a category error.

An enzyme wet step that hydrolyses protruding cellulosic micro-fibrils so light abrasion snaps them off, de-fuzzing and softening cotton durably; it removes fibre and therefore costs tensile strength, must be enzyme-inactivated (alkali/heat) afterwards, and does nothing on acrylic or wool.

The trap where a heavily silicone-softened sample feels premium in the showroom and harsh after one home wash, masking a harsh underlying yarn; defended by specifying a wash-durable softener and testing the hand after a wash, hydrophilic silicone on cotton and amino-silicone on wool.

Stored knit stress released the first time the fabric is wetted; common to all fibres and non-reversible, so it must be spent in the factory (wet/tumble/kier-relax) and then compacted to a residual-shrink limit and steam-set, not left for the customer's washing machine.

The finishing recipe spans two purchase orders: the yarn supplier does singe and mercerise, the garment finisher does scour/bio-polish/mill/soften/press/relax; both POs must carry the same post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate or a step skipped at one vendor quietly passes the test at the other.

The pilling-box test method for soft/whole-garment sweater knits, grading 1 (severe) to 5 (none) to the nearest half-grade after >=1 home wash; the correct method (not ISO 12945-2 Martindale, which suits flatter/denser fabric), and the spec must name the method and post-wash condition, not just the number.

The inherited non-negotiable posture: outsource 100% of wet/skilled/regulated finishing steps and never own a dyehouse or any effluent node, because wet processing makes regulated effluent (cluster CETP non-compliance, CPCB penalties, NGT review) and the kit is capital/skill/volume-bound for a micro-line; the only ownable sliver is the two-PO recipe + the finished-garment gate.

The eight-check finished-garment post-wash acceptance gate (pilling, shrinkage, spirality, retained strength, hand durability, milling felt-limit, shade delta-E/fastness, workmanship AQL) that is the garment-side half of the per-lot scorecard-and-code returned to the named supplier, extending the yarn-lot gate onto the garment so both ends are tested.

nodes.definition: Lay out the post-knit finishing spine every sweater passes through and flag the steps that are not universal: knit panels -> linking/assembly -> scour/wash -> (WOOL A3 ONLY) mill/full -> the per-fibre anti-pill route -> soften -> extract/dry -> steam-press/board/block -> relax & shrink-control -> the finished-garment gate. Dyeing is not a single step in this chain but a stage-of-chain choice handled separately. The spine is a FACT for the step identities and an [ESTIMATE: process-reasoning, HIGH] for which garment uses which step; the governing fact it surfaces is that no garment uses every step, so writing one generic finishing line across cotton/acrylic/wool produces either a no-op or damage.

included: the ordered post-knit step sequence
which steps are wool-only or per-fibre
dyeing as a stage-choice not a chain step

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a finishing step, its order, or its per-fibre applicability changes

pros.claim: A single ordered spine prevents specifying steps out of order or applying a wool-only step to cotton
pros.example: placing mill before anti-pill and marking it A3-only stops a cotton recipe from inheriting a felting step it must never run

cons.claim: A linear spine can read as if every garment runs every step when several are conditional

nodes.definition: Establish the first wet step under every finish: scour/wash strips spinning oils, knit lubricants (paraffin/wax), sizing and lint so later finishes deposit evenly and the loops relax. It is [FACT] as a wet-processing-sequence identity. Its failure mode is decisive and [ESTIMATE: process-reasoning, HIGH]: under-scouring leaves residual oil, so softener uptake goes on patchy and shade looks uneven, and a finish applied over residual oil goes on blotchy. Because softening, anti-pill and dye evenness all sit downstream of scour, a skipped or weak scour quietly degrades every later step, which is why it is the silent prerequisite of the whole chain rather than an optional clean-up.

included: what scour removes and why even deposition needs it
the under-scouring patchy-uptake/shade failure
its position as the prerequisite first wet step

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a scour input, defect rate, or downstream-finish baseline changes

pros.claim: Naming scour as the silent prerequisite stops blotchy finishes being blamed on the softener instead of the wash
pros.example: tracing patchy softener uptake back to residual spinning oil rather than a bad silicone batch

cons.claim: Scour is cheap and invisible, so it is easy to under-spec and assume away
cons.example: a recipe that lists softening and pressing but never specifies a scour acceptance condition

failure_modes: under-scouring so later softener/dye goes on patchy
treating scour as optional cleanup rather than the deposition prerequisite
acceptance_tests: the step states what scour removes, why even deposition depends on it, and the under-scouring patchy-uptake/shade failure
revisit_triggers: a spinning oil/lubricant change alters the scour load
a patchy-finish defect recurs

nodes.definition: Define the wool-only finishing step and its single most destructive failure. Milling/fulling is controlled wet+heat+agitation that felts and closes up a woollen knit into a fuller, softer, warmer, hairier hand; it is [FACT — woolmark/woolwise] the same physics as accidental shrink-felting, deliberately stopped at a target. Worsted/merino is milled lightly or not at all. It is irreversible if over-done — the single most destructive finishing failure — so it is gated on dimensions + a felt/area-shrink limit + hand, never to the clock. Time is the dial and it is short (minutes); a representative ~39-41 C / 8-12 min window is [ESTIMATE: industry-lore, single-source, MED — order-of-magnitude only]. It applies only to A3 woollen-spun and must never be written generically as wash-and-mill across cotton or acrylic.

included: milling as deliberately-stopped shrink-felting
wool-only applicability and worsted/merino light-or-none
the felt/area-shrink gate not a clock and the irreversibility

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a wool grade, felt-limit, or milling failure changes

pros.claim: Gating milling on a felt/area-shrink limit instead of a clock prevents the irreversible over-felt that destroys a wool garment
pros.example: stopping a merino mill on a measured area-shrink target rather than a fixed minute count

cons.claim: The published temp/time window is single-source order-of-magnitude, so it cannot be quoted as a recipe setpoint
cons.example: treating ~40 C / 10 min as a guaranteed setting rather than a starting band to dial in at sampling

failure_modes: over-milling into irreversible felt/shrink
writing wash-and-mill generically across cotton or acrylic
gating milling on time instead of a felt/area-shrink limit
acceptance_tests: the step states milling is wool-only, irreversible, gated on a felt/area-shrink limit and hand not a clock, with the temp/time window flagged order-of-magnitude
revisit_triggers: a wool grade or woollen-vs-worsted spec changes
a felt/area-shrink limit is tightened by a buyer

nodes.definition: Hold the load-bearing truth of the whole KB: pilling is tangled balls of broken/loose surface fibres, the #1 post-purchase complaint and main return driver, and there are exactly four real anti-pill routes, each attached to a fibre and none universal. (1) Singeing/gassing — yarn-stage, cotton — burns off surface fuzz. (2) Cellulase bio-polish — garment wet step, cotton/cellulosic only — snaps off micro-fibrils. (3) Chemical/silicone bonding — acrylic primary, wool/cotton adjunct — anchors fibres, buys only a fraction of a grade. (4) Low-pill fibre + nylon% — upstream in the yarn PO, NOT a finish — the biggest single lever. The route is dictated by fibre chemistry, so writing a generic wash-and-anti-pill across cotton/acrylic/wool is a category error producing a no-op or damage [ESTIMATE: industry-lore, HIGH]. Finishing is the second line of defence; the yarn PO sets the floor.

included: the four routes and the fibre each attaches to
the no-universal-finish category-error rule
finishing as second line, yarn PO as floor

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an anti-pill route, its fibre fit, or its quantified uplift changes

pros.claim: Mapping each route to its fibre kills the most expensive spec lie that one anti-pill finish works on every sweater
pros.example: refusing a generic anti-pill line and routing cotton to singe+bio-polish while acrylic stays in the yarn PO

cons.claim: A four-route map can read as if finishing can always add a grade when on acrylic it adds only a fraction
cons.example: over-reading the chemical route as a real grade on A2 rather than a top-up

failure_modes: specifying a generic anti-pill finish across all fibres
treating finishing as the first line and underspecifying the yarn floor
acceptance_tests: the map names all four routes with their fibre, states there is no universal anti-pill finish, and places finishing as the second line behind the yarn floor
revisit_triggers: a new anti-pill chemistry is validated
an article's fibre route changes
a PPS swatch trial quantifies a route's uplift

nodes.definition: Detail the yarn-stage anti-pill route. In singeing/gassing the yarn passes through a gas flame so protruding surface fuzz burns off, yielding a low-hairiness, lustrous yarn with fewer pill anchors [FACT — textiletradebuddy/iosrjournals]. It serves cotton (A1) and cotton-rich/viscose blends and cuts surface fibre dramatically, virtually eliminating cotton pilling; a cited ~26% air-drag reduction figure is single-source [ESTIMATE, decorative/order-of-magnitude]. Critically it happens at the yarn supplier (the yarn-PO half of the two-PO recipe), and it does NOT work on acrylic: acrylic is thermoplastic so a flame beads/melts it rather than cleanly singeing it. Gassing pairs with mercerising as the standard premium-cotton combo.

included: the gas-flame mechanism and cotton fit
the yarn-stage (yarn-PO) location
why it fails on thermoplastic acrylic

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: singe availability, a blend's cellulosic share, or a pre-singed buy-in changes

pros.claim: Singeing dramatically cuts cotton surface fibre and pill anchors at the cheapest stage to do it
pros.example: gassed cotton yarn arriving low-hairiness so the knit pills far less before any garment step

cons.claim: It is fibre-bound to cotton/cellulosics and cannot be used on the acrylic value article
cons.example: attempting to singe acrylic and beading/melting the surface instead of cleaning it

failure_modes: specifying singeing on acrylic where the flame beads/melts it
assuming the air-drag figure is a measured guarantee
acceptance_tests: the route states the gas-flame mechanism, the cotton/cellulosic fit, the yarn-stage location, and that it fails on thermoplastic acrylic
revisit_triggers: singe job-work availability/MOQ at a named Ludhiana yarn supplier surfaces
a blend's cellulosic share changes its singe fit
a pre-singed-yarn buy-in is chosen over local singeing

nodes.definition: Detail the garment-stage cotton anti-pill route and its mandatory cap. A cellulase enzyme hydrolyses protruding cellulosic micro-fibrils and light abrasion snaps them off, giving a clean, low-fuzz, softer, wash-durable, non-greasy fabric [FACT — sciencedirect/shreebschemicals]. It serves cotton (A1) and cellulosics ONLY and does nothing on acrylic or wool. Because it removes fibre — that is how it de-fuzzes — it costs tensile/bursting strength, so the spec must name BOTH the target hand AND a minimum retained bursting/tensile strength; over-treat and the sweater is weak, thin and returnable. The enzyme must be inactivated (alkali/heat) afterwards or it keeps eating cellulose into strength loss. This is the step where A1 finishing earns a real, ownable, verifiable anti-pill grade.

included: the cellulase de-fuzz mechanism and cotton/cellulosic-only fit
the retained-strength cap and enzyme inactivation
the wash-durable real-grade nature for A1

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a retained-strength cap, bio-polish availability, or a strength-hand trial changes

pros.claim: Bio-polish gives cotton a durable, real anti-pill grade plus a softer hand at the garment stage
pros.example: a 12GG cotton-blend coming off bio-polish clean and low-fuzz with a measurably softer hand

cons.claim: It trades strength for de-fuzzing, so without a retained-strength cap it produces a weak, returnable garment
cons.example: an over-cellulased sweater that feels great but bursts on a strength test

failure_modes: over-treating past the retained-strength minimum
failing to inactivate the enzyme so it keeps eating cellulose
applying cellulase to acrylic or wool where it does nothing
acceptance_tests: the route states the cellulase mechanism, the cellulosic-only fit, the mandatory retained-strength cap, and the enzyme-inactivation requirement
revisit_triggers: a retained-strength minimum is set or changed by a buyer
bio-polish job-work availability/MOQ at a named Ludhiana finisher surfaces
a PPS strength-vs-hand trial result lands

nodes.definition: Detail the chemical/silicone anti-pill route and bound its value. A polymer/resin/silicone anchors surface fibres so they can't pull free and tangle; it serves acrylic (A2) primary with wool/cotton as adjunct, and lifts the grade BUT can stiffen the hand and risk fastness/feel, buying only a fraction of a grade [ESTIMATE: industry-lore, MED-HIGH]. The blunt rule it enforces: acrylic's ICI grade is won or lost at the yarn PO (anti-pill/high-dpf grade, higher twist, 2-ply, tight gauge), not on the finishing line, so the chemical top-up is the only finishing option on A2 and is worth only a fraction. How much a top-up actually buys on A2 is [UNKNOWN] (direction small); if forced onto cheap acrylic the fix is to re-open the yarn spec, not pile on chemical anti-pill.

included: the resin/silicone bonding mechanism and acrylic-primary fit
the fraction-of-a-grade ceiling and hand/fastness risk
the re-open-the-yarn-spec rule for cheap acrylic

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: an acrylic top-up grade gain, yarn-grade change, or fastness defect occurs

pros.claim: Naming chemical anti-pill as a fraction-only top-up stops it from being treated as an acrylic rescue
pros.example: specifying a light silicone top-up on A2 while keeping the real defence in the yarn PO

cons.claim: Pushed hard it stiffens hand and risks fastness for little grade gain
cons.example: an over-resined acrylic that grades barely higher but feels boardy and loses fastness

failure_modes: piling on chemical anti-pill to rescue a cheap acrylic yarn
over-applying resin/silicone into a stiff hand and fastness loss
acceptance_tests: the route states the bonding mechanism, the acrylic-primary fit, the fraction-of-a-grade ceiling, and the re-open-the-yarn-spec rule
revisit_triggers: a PPS trial quantifies the acrylic top-up grade gain
an acrylic yarn anti-pill grade is downgraded forcing a finishing top-up decision
a fastness/hand defect from over-resining occurs

nodes.definition: Define what softening owns and the trap it carries. Silicone (amino- or hydrophilic) or fatty-cationic deposit gives the expensive 3-second hand and lowers wear abrasion [FACT — silicone softeners, USPTO 5102930]. But it can MASK a harsh yarn: a heavily-softened sample feels great in the showroom and harsh after one wash [ESTIMATE: industry-lore/judgment, MED-HIGH]. So the spec must require a wash-durable softener and test the hand AFTER a wash, not in the showroom. Chemistry is fibre-matched: hydrophilic silicone on cotton (A1) to keep it breathable, amino-silicone on wool (A3) for the luxe hand (accepting amino-silicone's hydrophobicity/yellowing trade). Softening owns the retail hand for every article but never substitutes for a sound yarn.

included: the silicone hand and abrasion benefit
the masking trap and the after-wash hand test
hydrophilic-on-cotton vs amino-on-wool chemistry

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a softener chemistry, post-wash hand complaint, or care story changes

pros.claim: Requiring a wash-durable softener and an after-wash hand test defeats the showroom masking trap
pros.example: rejecting a sample that felt premium dry but harsh after one wash instead of shipping it

cons.claim: Softener masking is precisely what makes a bad yarn pass a showroom feel test, so it is easy to be fooled
cons.example: approving a heavily-softened harsh acrylic on hand alone and eating returns one wash later

failure_modes: testing hand only in the showroom and missing the post-wash harshness
using amino-silicone on breathable cotton and losing hydrophilicity
letting softening substitute for a sound yarn
acceptance_tests: the step states the silicone hand benefit, the masking trap, the wash-durable + after-wash test requirement, and the hydrophilic-cotton vs amino-wool split
revisit_triggers: a softener chemistry or care-label story changes
a post-wash harshness complaint recurs
a wash-durability spec is tightened

nodes.definition: Establish where the tech-pack measurements are actually hit. Steam-press/board/block applies heat + moisture (with or without a garment-shaped form) to set final dimensions and relax knit stress [FACT — steam-under-tension, researchgate]. Steam-under-tension lowers later relaxation shrinkage; rushed pressing shows as twisted seams, asymmetric panels and wavy hems. Boarding/form-pressing is critical for the fully-fashioned premium read on A3 [ESTIMATE, MED-HIGH], where the shaped-panel quality story is delivered. By article: A1 steam-press + light board; A2 steam-press but under-set because excess heat glazes thermoplastic acrylic; A3 board/form-press as a critical premium step. This is the step that converts a relaxed, anti-pilled, softened garment into one that meets the tech-pack and looks premium on the shelf.

included: heat+moisture dimension-setting and stress relaxation
the FF boarding premium read on A3 and the acrylic glazing caution
rushed-pressing appearance defects

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a measurement tolerance, pressing defect, or per-article press setting changes

pros.claim: Steam-under-tension both hits the tech-pack measurements and pre-pays later relaxation shrinkage
pros.example: boarding a fully-fashioned merino to spec so it reads premium and shrinks less in the first wash

cons.claim: Rushed or over-hot pressing shows as twisted seams and, on acrylic, a permanent glaze
cons.example: over-pressing A2 acrylic into a shiny glazed face that can't be undone

failure_modes: rushed pressing producing twisted seams and wavy hems
over-heating acrylic into a permanent glaze
skipping the boarding step that delivers the FF premium read
acceptance_tests: the step states heat+moisture dimension-setting, the FF boarding premium read, the acrylic under-set caution, and the rushed-pressing defects
revisit_triggers: a tech-pack measurement tolerance changes
an acrylic glazing or twisted-seam defect recurs
an article moves between board and light-press

nodes.definition: Define the all-fibre dimensional step that delivers the home-wash promise. Relaxation shrinkage is stored knit stress released the first time the fabric is wetted; it is common to all fibres and non-reversible [FACT — relaxation-shrinkage, sciencedirect/researchgate]. conflict_axes.name: universal_vs_fibre_specific_antipill
conflict_axes.description: A single generic anti-pill line is convenient to spec, but the route is dictated by fibre chemistry so a universal finish is a no-op or damage.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: always route anti-pill by fibre (singe/bio-polish cotton, chemical acrylic, nylon%+craft wool); refuse a generic wash-and-anti-pill

conflict_axes.name: showroom_hand_vs_post_wash_durability
conflict_axes.description: Silicone softening makes a harsh yarn feel premium dry, masking it, while the post-wash hand is what the customer keeps.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: require a wash-durable softener and grade hand only after >=1 wash; never approve on the dry showroom feel

conflict_axes.name: milling_fuller_hand_vs_irreversible_felt
conflict_axes.description: More milling time gives a fuller, warmer wool hand but over-milling felts irreversibly and destroys measurements.
poles: mill longer for a fuller hand
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: gate milling on a felt/area-shrink limit and hand, never to the clock; the irreversible step bounds the hand

conflict_axes.name: bio_polish_defuzz_vs_retained_strength
conflict_axes.description: Cellulase de-fuzzes cotton by removing fibre, which costs tensile/bursting strength, so more de-fuzz means a weaker garment.
poles: de-fuzz harder for a cleaner face
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: name both the target hand and a minimum retained strength; stop bio-polish at the strength cap and inactivate the enzyme

conflict_axes.name: own_the_process_vs_outsource_the_wet
conflict_axes.description: Owning wet kit gives process control but imports effluent/closure risk and idle cost at micro volume; outsourcing keeps risk off but cedes metrology.
poles: own the wet process for control
outsource all wet and own only the gate
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: outsource 100% of wet/regulated steps and own only the two-PO recipe + gate; leverage is contractual not a machine

conflict_axes.name: single_vendor_vs_two_po_same_gate
conflict_axes.description: A single-vendor inspection is simpler, but the recipe spans a yarn PO and a finishing PO, so one ungated PO lets a skipped step pass at the other.
poles: carry the same gate across both POs
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: carry the identical post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate on both the yarn PO and the finishing PO

conflict_axes.name: dye_fastness_vs_agility
conflict_axes.description: Earlier-stage dyeing (fibre/yarn) gives consistency and fastness but commits colour early; garment-dye gives agility but shifts measurements and weakens fastness.
poles: dye early for fastness and consistency
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: launch yarn/package-dyed for consistency + patterning, reserve garment-dye for a proven hero style, never piece-dye-and-cut as core

conflict_axes.name: acrylic_glaze_press_vs_under_set
conflict_axes.description: Hotter pressing sets acrylic measurements faster but excess heat permanently glazes the thermoplastic face.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: under-set the acrylic press to avoid an irreversible glaze, accepting a gentler dimension-set

edge_cases.description: A heavily-softened sample passes the showroom feel test then turns harsh after one home wash
edge_cases.trigger: a non-wash-durable silicone masks a harsh yarn
edge_cases.mitigation: require a wash-durable softener and grade the hand only after >=1 wash, not in the showroom

edge_cases.description: A wool garment is over-milled into irreversible felt and loses its measurements
edge_cases.trigger: milling is gated to the clock instead of a felt/area-shrink limit
edge_cases.mitigation: gate milling on a felt/area-shrink limit and hand and stop short; the step is irreversible

edge_cases.description: An over-bio-polished cotton de-fuzzes well but fails the retained-strength check and is returnable
edge_cases.trigger: cellulase runs past the retained-strength minimum or the enzyme is not inactivated
edge_cases.mitigation: name a minimum retained bursting/tensile strength, stop at the cap, and inactivate the enzyme afterwards

edge_cases.description: A generic wash-and-anti-pill is specified across cotton, acrylic and wool and is a no-op or damage
edge_cases.trigger: anti-pill is written line-generic instead of fibre-routed
edge_cases.mitigation: route anti-pill per fibre and refuse a universal anti-pill finish

edge_cases.description: Singeing or cellulase is specified on the acrylic value article where neither works
edge_cases.trigger: a cotton route is copied onto thermoplastic non-cellulosic acrylic
edge_cases.mitigation: keep acrylic on a silicone/chemical fraction top-up and win the grade at the yarn PO

edge_cases.description: A step skipped at the yarn vendor passes the test because only the finishing vendor is gated
edge_cases.trigger: one of the two POs is left ungated
edge_cases.mitigation: carry the identical post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate on both POs

edge_cases.description: Pilling is graded on ISO 12945-2 Martindale or pre-wash and overstates real-world performance
edge_cases.trigger: the wrong method or a pre-wash grade is accepted
edge_cases.mitigation: spec ISO 12945-1 box, 1-5 half-grade after >=1 wash, the method named not just the number

edge_cases.description: Acrylic is over-pressed into a permanent glaze on the thermoplastic face
edge_cases.trigger: the acrylic press is run too hot instead of under-set
edge_cases.mitigation: under-set the acrylic press to avoid the irreversible glaze

edge_cases.description: A garment-dye drop shifts final measurements via dye-bath shrinkage on a fine 12GG knit
edge_cases.trigger: garment-dye is used as the launch default rather than a proven hero style
edge_cases.mitigation: launch yarn/package-dyed and reserve garment-dye for a later proven hero with a sample dye trial first

edge_cases.description: A tumble-dry US household outruns the +/-3-5% residual-shrink working target
edge_cases.trigger: the compact limit is set to a band the buyer's care reality exceeds
edge_cases.mitigation: confirm the residual-shrink tolerance per buyer and compact tighter for a tumble-dry customer

edge_cases.description: The per-garment finishing cost band is fed as a point into the bottom-up cost model
edge_cases.trigger: a triangulated estimate band is treated as a measured per-vendor rate
edge_cases.mitigation: keep the band an estimate, keep the per-garment job-work rate UNKNOWN, and block the model until a live Ludhiana quote

edge_cases.description: Under-scouring leaves residual oil so the softener and shade go on patchy
edge_cases.trigger: a weak or skipped scour before downstream finishes
edge_cases.mitigation: specify a scour acceptance condition so deposition is even before softening and dyeing

workflow.action: Lay out the post-knit finishing spine
workflow.description: State the ordered steps and mark milling wool-only and the anti-pill route per-fibre
workflow.gate: every step is ordered with milling wool-only and the anti-pill route flagged per-fibre

workflow.description: State what scour removes and the under-scouring patchy-uptake failure
workflow.gate: scour's removal load and the under-scouring patchy-uptake/shade failure are stated

workflow.action: Map the four fibre-specific anti-pill routes
workflow.description: Name singe, bio-polish, chemical and low-pill-fibre+nylon and the no-universal-finish rule
workflow.gate: all four routes name their fibre and the no-universal-anti-pill rule is stated

workflow.action: Detail the cotton routes and the strength cap
workflow.description: State gas-singe (yarn) and cellulase (garment) with the mandatory retained-strength cap and enzyme inactivation
workflow.gate: the cellulosic-only fit, the retained-strength cap and the enzyme inactivation are stated

workflow.action: Bound the acrylic and wool routes
workflow.description: State the acrylic chemical fraction ceiling and the re-open-the-yarn rule, and place wool on nylon%+craft
workflow.gate: the fraction-of-a-grade ceiling and the re-open-the-yarn-spec rule are stated

workflow.action: Set the softener hand and anti-masking test
workflow.description: State the silicone hand, the masking trap, the after-wash test and the hydrophilic-cotton/amino-wool split
workflow.gate: the wash-durable + after-wash hand test and the per-fibre softener chemistry are stated

workflow.action: Set the press/board and relax/compact dimensions
workflow.description: State steam-under-tension measurement-setting and relaxation shrinkage spent in-factory then compacted to a residual limit
workflow.gate: the measurement-setting, the residual-shrink limit confirm-per-buyer and spirality are stated

workflow.description: State milling is wool-only, irreversible, and gated on a felt/area-shrink limit not a clock
workflow.gate: milling is stated wool-only, irreversible, and felt/area-shrink-limit-gated not clock-gated

workflow.action: Establish the two-PO split and shared gate
workflow.description: State which steps sit in the yarn PO vs the finishing PO and the same-gate-on-both rule
workflow.gate: the yarn-PO vs finishing-PO split and the same-gate-on-both-POs rule are stated

workflow.action: Set the outsource boundary and the ownable sliver
workflow.description: State outsource 100% of wet steps and own only the two-PO recipe + finished-garment gate with contractual leverage
workflow.gate: the outsource-all-wet rule and the recipe+gate ownable sliver with contractual leverage are stated

workflow.action: Assemble the eight-check garment gate and dye choice
workflow.description: List the eight post-wash checks feeding the scorecard and set the dye stage launch on yarn/package-dyed
workflow.gate: the eight post-wash checks with per-article flags and the yarn/package-dyed launch with delta-E/fastness clause are stated

workflow.action: Issue the merged per-article spec/no-spec verdict
workflow.description: Compose fibre route, irreversible guard, anti-masking test and shared gate into the A1/A2/A3 calls
workflow.gate: the verdict states each article's route, irreversible guard, anti-masking test and shared gate and refuses any finishing-fixes-cheap-yarn recipe

priority_rationale: The finishing chain spine and scour come first because every later step and every per-fibre branch depends on the ordered sequence and a clean first wet step; the four-route anti-pill map and its singe/bio-polish/chemical detail next, because the load-bearing truth (anti-pill is fibre-specific, finishing is the second line) governs every recipe; the softening, press/board and relax/compact process steps and the milling/mercerise specials next, because they own the hand and the home-wash promise and carry the irreversible and masking traps; the two-PO split, the outsource boundary and the ownable spec+gate then fix the make-vs-buy posture; the pilling method and eight-check garment gate plus the dye-stage choice establish how pass/fail is measured and coded back; and the three per-article recipes and the merged go/no-go come last because they compose every upstream output into a defensible per-article spec/no-spec verdict that refuses any recipe promising finishing will fix a cheap yarn.

dominance_rules.rule: The fibre route dominates any generic anti-pill spec
dominance_rules.rationale: the route is dictated by fibre chemistry so a universal finish is a no-op or damage
dominance_rules.trigger: anti-pill is written line-generic across fibres
dominance_rules.action: route anti-pill per fibre and refuse a universal anti-pill finish

dominance_rules.rule: The yarn PO dominates the finishing line for the anti-pill grade
dominance_rules.rationale: finishing is the second line of defence and on acrylic buys only a fraction of a grade
dominance_rules.trigger: a recipe leans on finishing to lift a cheap yarn's grade
dominance_rules.action: set the grade at the yarn PO and re-open the yarn spec rather than pile on chemical anti-pill

dominance_rules.rule: The post-wash test dominates the showroom hand
dominance_rules.rationale: silicone softening can mask a harsh yarn that fails after one wash
dominance_rules.trigger: a sample is approved on the dry showroom feel
dominance_rules.action: require a wash-durable softener and grade hand and pilling only after >=1 home wash

dominance_rules.rule: The felt/area-shrink limit dominates milling time
dominance_rules.rationale: over-milling felts irreversibly and destroys measurements
dominance_rules.trigger: milling is gated to the clock
dominance_rules.action: gate milling on a felt/area-shrink limit and hand and stop short

dominance_rules.rule: The retained-strength cap dominates bio-polish de-fuzzing
dominance_rules.rationale: cellulase removes fibre so harder de-fuzz means a weaker, returnable garment
dominance_rules.trigger: bio-polish is pushed for a cleaner face without a strength floor
dominance_rules.action: name a minimum retained strength, stop at the cap, and inactivate the enzyme

dominance_rules.rule: The same gate on both POs dominates single-vendor inspection
dominance_rules.rationale: an ungated yarn PO lets a skipped step pass at the finishing vendor and vice-versa
dominance_rules.trigger: only one of the two POs is gated
dominance_rules.action: carry the identical post-wash ICI + shrinkage gate on both POs

dominance_rules.rule: The outsource-all-wet boundary dominates any in-house wet ambition
dominance_rules.rationale: owning a wet/effluent node imports cluster closure risk out of proportion to a three-article line
dominance_rules.trigger: a plan proposes owning a wet/dye/effluent step
dominance_rules.action: outsource 100% of wet/regulated steps and own only the two-PO recipe + gate

dominance_rules.rule: The UNKNOWN job-work rate dominates a fabricated cost point
dominance_rules.rationale: the per-garment finishing rate at a named Ludhiana finisher is genuinely missing and blocks the bottom-up model
dominance_rules.trigger: a finishing cost is needed for the model
dominance_rules.action: keep the band an estimate, keep the rate UNKNOWN, and name it as the blocker until a live quote lands

anti_rework_rules.rule: Route anti-pill per fibre from the first draft of the recipe
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a generic anti-pill line being specified and then retracted as a no-op or damage

anti_rework_rules.rule: Name the bio-polish retained-strength cap when the route is written, not after a failure
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an over-bio-polished cotton lot shipping weak and returning

anti_rework_rules.rule: Gate milling on a felt/area-shrink limit before the first wool lot runs
anti_rework_rules.prevents: an irreversible over-mill that cannot be undone

anti_rework_rules.rule: Grade hand and pilling after a wash, never on the showroom sample
anti_rework_rules.prevents: approving a softener-masked harsh yarn that fails one wash later

anti_rework_rules.rule: Carry the identical gate on both the yarn PO and the finishing PO from the outset
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a skipped step at one vendor passing the test at the other and surfacing only on returns

anti_rework_rules.rule: Keep the per-garment finishing rate UNKNOWN and the cost band an estimate
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a fabricated cost point feeding the bottom-up model and having to be retracted

anti_rework_rules.rule: Reserve garment-dye for a proven hero style and sample-dye-trial it first
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a launch garment-dye drop shifting measurements and forcing a re-grade

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the residual-shrink tolerance per buyer before setting the compact limit
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a tumble-dry customer outrunning a working +/-3-5% target and driving returns

iteration_protocol.trigger: a live per-garment finishing job-work quote at a named Ludhiana finisher lands
iteration_protocol.action: replace the estimate cost bands with the quote, lift the UNKNOWN rate, and unblock the bottom-up model

iteration_protocol.trigger: a PPS swatch trial quantifies the ICI-grade uplift per route on the exact constructions
iteration_protocol.action: replace the directional uplift with the measured magnitude and re-rank confidence on the routes

iteration_protocol.trigger: gas-singe or cellulase bio-polish availability/MOQ/price as local Ludhiana job-work is confirmed
iteration_protocol.action: confirm whether A1's real route exists in-cluster or must be designed around (pre-singed yarn, skip local bio-polish)

iteration_protocol.trigger: in-cluster wool-milling capacity and felt-control reliability are confirmed
iteration_protocol.action: update the A3 buy-the-craft risk and the milling gate with the capacity/seasonality finding

iteration_protocol.trigger: a buyer sets a tighter residual-shrink tolerance or a tumble-dry care assumption changes
iteration_protocol.action: tighten the compact limit and the dimensional-stability gate check

iteration_protocol.trigger: a proven hero style justifies a garment-dye drop
iteration_protocol.action: run a sample dye trial for measurement/fastness shift before committing and update the dye choice

iteration_protocol.trigger: a test standard revision or a buyer changes the pilling method, revolution count or wash cycle
iteration_protocol.action: update the pilling method node and re-state the gate's master check
